title: Pick-up work with Petit, Kelly, Celestin and the Young Tuxedo band
summary: He subbed with Buddy Petit, Chris Kelly and Celestin, but his regular band was Cloverleaf; he replaced an ill drummer in the Young Tuxedo band for almost a year.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: Can you remember any other bands now that you played with? Sorry, you mentioned your brother's band and Euless Jean, some of the very earliest ones.
Well, I played in rake up bands like I played with Buddy Petit. I played with Chris Kelly. I played with Celestine too.
How long were you with Chris Kelly? Do you remember who else was in the band? No, well, I just played at Giles when he hired me like that, you know, when he was drumming.
But I never was in the regular. My regular was with Cloverleaf and when Saeed was taken sick, I played in his place almost a year. Probably in the Young Tuxedo band. In the Young Tuxedo?
Yeah, huh. That's the one that the picture was taken. Yeah, uh-huh.
